description: Sync the Superhuman docs you choose: one document for each doc's details, one per page with its content, and one per table row. Superhuman permissions are not imported.
opening: Sync the Superhuman docs you select. Each doc gives one document with its owner, workspace and folder, one document per page with the page's content, and one document per table row with its cell values. A page links to its parent page, or to its doc at the top level. Files in a row's attachment columns are downloaded when Superhuman hosts them.

Superhuman permissions are not imported, so everything in the selected docs is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. The first sync reaches only items updated in the last 30 days unless you raise `lookback_days`. Docs, pages and rows deleted in Superhuman stay in HydraDB.

notes: Superhuman doc permissions are read but not applied.

connect.auth: Superhuman, formerly Coda, uses a Coda API token. The token belongs to an account, not to a workspace.

credentials.name: auth_token
credentials.text: A Coda API token for the account whose docs you want synced.

steps.title: Create an API token
steps.text: Create a Coda API token for the account whose docs you want synced.

steps.title: Select docs
steps.text: HydraDB lists the docs the token can reach. Select the docs to sync. You select docs one by one: a whole workspace cannot be selected. To reach items older than 30 days, raise `lookback_days` when you select them.

connect.account: One connector reads the docs one account's token can reach.

sync.first_sync: Each selected doc reads back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default.
sync.changes: Each sync reads the docs, pages and rows updated since the last sync. A change to a page's content sends that page again.
sync.edits: An edited doc, page or row is read again and replaces its document.
sync.deletes: Deleted docs, pages and rows are not removed. They stay searchable in HydraDB.

shared_attributes.name: updated_at
shared_attributes.text: When the doc, page or row was last updated, written as the `Updated` line. Sets the result date.

shared_attributes.name: created_at
shared_attributes.text: When the item was created. Sets the result date only when the update time is missing. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.coda_doc_id
shared_attributes.text: The doc id. Limits a query to one doc, with its pages and rows. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's items. Not searchable.

documents.name: Docs
documents.one_document: One doc's details. The doc's pages and table rows are their own documents.
documents.title: The doc name. A doc with no name is titled `Coda doc` and its id.
documents.text: The title, then `Owner`, `Workspace`, `Folder` and `Link` lines, leaving out empty ones.
documents.date: When the doc was last updated, else when it was created.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.text: The name of the doc's owner, written as the `Owner` line, so a doc can be found by owner. The owner is not attached to the doc as a person in the graph.

attributes.name: workspace_name
attributes.text: The workspace that holds the doc, written as the `Workspace` line.

attributes.name: url
attributes.text: The doc's link, written as the `Link` line.

documents.name: Pages
documents.one_document: One page of a doc, with its content.
documents.title: The page name. A page with no name is titled `Coda page` and its id.
documents.text: The page's content as text, with its title and subtitle. A very large page can be cut short.
documents.date: When the page was last updated, else when it was created.

attributes.name: subtitle
attributes.text: The page subtitle, written as a `Subtitle` line.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.coda_page_id
attributes.text: The page id. Picks out one page. Not searchable.

attributes.name: parent_id
attributes.text: The parent page, or the doc for a top-level page. Links the page to it, so a doc's page tree is connected. Not searchable.

attributes.name: doc_id
attributes.text: The id of the doc that holds the page. To limit a query to a doc, use `additional_metadata.coda_doc_id`.

attributes.name: page_content_elements
attributes.text: How many content elements were read from the page, blank ones included. Not a measure of how much text is searchable.

attributes.name: page_content_truncated
attributes.text: True when the page's content was too large and was cut short.

documents.name: Table rows
documents.title: The table name, a dash and the row name. A row with no name is titled by its table alone. When the table is not known, the row name alone, or `Coda row` and its id.
documents.text: The title, a `Table` line when the table is known, then each non-empty cell as a labelled line, in column order. A column whose name is not known is labelled with its id and comes last. Money values show the amount and currency. Numbers are rounded to six decimal places. Cell values HydraDB cannot show as text are left out. A column that refers to another row is text, not a link.
documents.date: When the row was last updated, else when it was created.
documents.link_back: Opens the row in Superhuman, or its table when the row has no link.
documents.files: Files in attachment columns are downloaded so their text can be read, but only when they are hosted on coda.io or codahosted.io. Links to files elsewhere are dropped.

attributes.name: table_name
attributes.text: The row's table. Starts the title and is the `Table` line, so rows can be found by table.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.coda_table_id
attributes.text: The table id. Limits a query to one table's rows. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.coda_row_id
attributes.text: The row id. Picks out one row. Not searchable.

attributes.name: doc_id
attributes.text: The id of the doc that holds the row.

attributes.name: table_id
attributes.text: The id of the row's table.

example_searches: What does the Q4 planning doc say about hiring?
Which rows in the Roadmap table have status Blocked?
Who owns the Team Rituals doc?

connections: A page to its parent page, or to its doc for a top-level page.
Rows are not linked to their table or doc in the graph.
No links to items in other tools.
people: No people are attached. A doc owner's name is part of the doc's text only.
graph.from_text: The doc details, page content and row cell values.

not_synced: Items last updated before the `lookback_days` window on the first sync.
Controls, formulas as definitions, and doc permissions. Formula results shown in row cells can still be searchable.
Files in attachment columns that are not hosted on coda.io or codahosted.io.
The rest of a very large page after it is cut short.
Deletions: deleted docs, pages and rows stay in HydraDB.
